Que Xuan Declares Himself

Word spreads in your court, that Que Xuan has boldly declared himself to be the true Son of Heaven. Casting aside restraint and doubt, he believes no force remains that can quell his ambition. What shall you do with this traitor?
Kong Rong Berates You

He condemns your rule as cruel, your authority as usurped, and your governance as the work of a tyrant clad in the trappings of order. He invokes the sages, the rites, and the Mandate itself, declaring that Heaven will not long tolerate such arrogance.
